text: For God so loved the world...
Trust in the LORD with all your heart...
The Lord is my shepherd...
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.
Let your light shine before others.
Love your neighbor as yourself.
Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness.
Do not be anxious about anything.
Commit to the LORD whatever you do, and He will establish your plans.
The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?
Create in me a pure heart, O God.
Cast all your anxiety on Him because He cares for you.
Do everything in love.
Praise the LORD, my soul.
Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him.
Be still, and know that I am God.
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
Do not let your hearts be troubled.
Walk in love, as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
Love does no harm to a neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
Trust in Him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts to Him.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up.
Faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.
Cast your burden on the LORD, and He will sustain you.
Be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
Serve wholeheartedly, as if you were serving the Lord.
Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him and He will act.
God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.
A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other.
God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline.
The LORD bless you and keep you; the LORD make His face shine on you.
Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done marvelous things.
Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in Him.
Let everything you say be good and helpful, so that your words will be an encouragement to those who hear them.
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you.
Rejoice in hope, be patient in tribulation, be constant in prayer.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly.
May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in Him.
